Pipeline stage (abstract parent class)

Source: R/classes.R
punkstStage.Rd

Common structure of the objects returned by punkst_pts2tiles(), punkst_tiles2hex() and punkst_topic_model(). punkstStage itself is abstract; use the subclasses punkstTiles, punkstHex and punkstModel.

Usage

punkstStage(workdir = character(0), files = list(), params = list())

punkstTiles(workdir = character(0), files = list(), params = list())

punkstHex(workdir = character(0), files = list(), params = list())

punkstModel(workdir = character(0), files = list(), params = list())

Arguments

workdir

Directory holding the stage's outputs.

files

Named list of output file paths. Required names: punkstTiles tsv, index, features; punkstHex data, meta; punkstModel model (plus state on punkst builds that write it, and results and pseudobulk when fitted with transform = TRUE).

params

Named list of the parameters that produced the outputs. These also drive the skip-if-up-to-date manifest and are recorded by sdata_writeback().

Value

An object of the respective subclass.

Examples

tiles <- punkstTiles(workdir = tempdir(),
    files = list(tsv = "tiled.tsv", index = "tiled.index", features = "tiled.features.tsv"),
    params = list(tile_size = 500))
tiles
#> <punkstTiles> in /tmp/RtmpAbIKEM
#>   tsv       tiled.tsv
#>   index     tiled.index
#>   features  tiled.features.tsv
